name: MSMT 2025 Africa DPRK IT-worker deployment estimates

attribution.legal_posture: Official MSMT assessment based on participating-state information; it reports an organizational relationship, while criminal judgment, sanctions, host-state admission, visa action, and local enforcement status require separate sources.

caveats: Historical reporting about identified people covers 2025. Their country-residence status remains unreported.
The record covers public reporting; local African prosecution, conviction, designation, visa action, company-registry adjudication and host-state admission require separate sources.

Source finding boundary: Faithful to an official MSMT report and its participating-state evidence posture. The reviewed source set leaves local African prosecution, conviction, designation, visa action, company-registry adjudication, and host-state admission unlocated. The 2025 Equatorial Guinea estimate is a later snapshot; placement of every person named in earlier UN reporting remains unverified.
The country-level assessment covers country conditions; individual identity, continuity, conduct, employer, and legal status require person-level sources.
The estimates are conservative early-2025 snapshots attributed to MSMT and participating-state reporting; they function as historical estimates rather than a census or projection to other dates.
Uganda is retained as a participating state's stated possibility; deployment remains unconfirmed.

infrastructure.evidence_boundary: MSMT synthesis of participating-state reporting; Uganda is not represented as a confirmed deployment.

sources.support: MSMT participating-state reporting identifies DPRK IT-worker delegations in Equatorial Guinea, Guinea, Nigeria, and Tanzania and gives conservative early-2025 estimates of 5–15, 5–10, fewer than 10, and fewer than 10, respectively. One participating state assessed only a possibility that DPRK IT workers might also reside in Uganda. This is an official aggregate assessment, not a host-state admission or adjudicated finding
sources.locator: Report pp. 8, 22, 55-56 / PDF pp. 10, 24, 57-58; especially country list, Bureau 53 item 1 and footnote 55, conservative estimates and footnotes 181-185
